title: Outline button
brief: A secondary button with a green outline that fills in on hover and shows an offset ring when reached with the keyboard.

inspiration.note: Took the idea of an outlined button that inverts to a solid fill on hover; ours is rounded, green and uses a detached focus ring.

inspiration.source: GitHub Primer link and button states
inspiration.note: Took the offset focus outline; palette and shape are our own.
